title: A Rat in the Bin
lines: Mom and Sid tip mud and buds in a bin.
The mud and buds rot in a pen.
"Buds rot in a hot bin," said Mom.
A rip is in the bin.
A rat hops in the rip!
"Not in the bin, rat!" said Sid.
Mom and Sid fit a cap on the rip.
The rat can not hop in the bin.
The rat hops up on a pot and naps.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
